business_problem: extract accurate answers from unstructured health-insurance documents and speed AI feature development so employees, HR teams, and customer-facing teams can understand benefits faster.
solution_summary: Healthee uses Snowflake and Cortex AI on Snowflake to extract accurate answers from unstructured health-insurance documents and speed AI feature development so employees, HR teams, and customer-facing teams can understand benefits faster. Application, customer, event, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so support, operations, and customer-success teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Healthee achieved 2 Weeks to migrate to Snowflake from legacy infrastructure and ~5x Faster development of new features.
